Wetness: 0 = satin, 1 = sharp clearcoat; also strengthens the pooled-fluid film.
Bump: Strength of normal perturbation from the flow noise and drips. 0 = smooth.
Scale: Frequency of the flowing noise in world units; higher = finer ripples.
Flow: Amount of the downward-flowing noise. 0 = none.
Dripscale: Density of drip columns along world X and Z; higher = more, narrower drips.
Dripamt: Strength of the falling drip beads and trails. 0 = no drips.
Roughness: Clearcoat roughness, i.e. blur of the environment reflection. 0 = mirror sharp.
Reflect: Gain of the clearcoat reflection of the environment.
Basecolor: Colour of the underlying near-black surface.
Speed: Speed of the material and preview animation. 1 = normal, 0 = frozen.
Envmix: Blend between the built-in procedural studio environment (0) and the equirect environment map on in1 (1).
Envrot: Rotates the environment around the vertical axis, 0-1 = one full turn.
Envgain: Brightness multiplier of the environment that is reflected or refracted.
Accent: Strength of the red accent light bar in the procedural environment. 0 = no red bar.
Resolution: Output size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Geometry: Preview shapes: both shows a sphere and a torus knot, sphere or knot shows only that one.
Spin: Number of full preview rotations per animation cycle. 0 = no spin.
Camdist: Preview camera distance from the objects in world units; larger = smaller objects.
Backdrop: Brightness of the preview background. 0 = black.
Exposure: Brightness multiplier applied to the preview render before tonemapping.
Vignette: Darkening of the preview corners. 0 = none, higher = stronger.
